title: 道歉信
goal: 能说明道歉事项和原因，并提出对应的补救安排。

points.label: 明确表达道歉事项与原因
选择能够补救具体问题的安排

sources.title: 高考英语（新课标卷）：课表
sources.used: 道歉信的结构、表达和知识点

cards.title: 结构
rows: I am sorry that I missed our meeting.
My train was delayed by a fallen tree.
Could we meet tomorrow at the same place?
礼貌表达希望获得谅解。
I hope you can forgive my absence.

cards.title: 常用表达
rows: for 后接名词或动名词。
I apologize for missing the meeting.
I am sorry that I missed the meeting.
I was late because the bus broke down.
I can deliver the replacement tomorrow.
I hope you can forgive the inconvenience.

body.box:
假定李华未能按时把借来的词典还给同学，需要道歉、说明原因并提出补救。
• Apologize for the late return.
• Explain the reason.
• Offer a remedy.
Draft: Dear Sam, I am sorry that I did not return your dictionary on Monday. I left it at home when I went to school. I can bring it to your classroom tomorrow morning. I hope you can forgive the delay. Best, Li Hua

body.p: 第一句说明没有按时还词典，第二句说明原因。第三句提出明早送到教室，直接解决词典还没还的问题。

cards.title: 常见错误
rows: I apologize for returning your book late.
The bus broke down on the way.
I am sorry I was late because the bus broke down.
I will buy a new notebook.
I will return your book tomorrow morning.
I will send the missing file this evening.

groups.text: 假定李华因公交车故障错过与同学的会议。

items.stem: Which sentence states the mistake and cause?
options: I am sorry I missed our meeting because my bus broke down.
I am sorry I missed our meeting yesterday afternoon.
I am sorry my bus broke down on the way this morning.
I am sorry I missed our meeting because I forgot the time.
items.why: 情境给出两点：错过会议，原因是公交车故障。第一项两点都说到了。第二项只说错过会议，没有原因。

groups.text: 假定李华忘记把活动照片发给同学。

options: I can take more photos at the next activity.
I can send the missing photos tonight.
I can check the colors of the photos.
I will send you something later.
items.why: 问题是照片没有发给同学。第二项今晚补发照片，直接解决这个问题。第四项没有说发什么、什么时候发。

groups.text: 假定李华因电脑故障迟交报告。

items.stem: Which sentence identifies the reason for the delay?
options: I submitted the report before the deadline yesterday.
I am sorry that my report was handed in late.
My computer failed before I could submit the report.
I forgot when the report was due.
items.why: 情境中迟交的原因是电脑故障。第三项说明提交前电脑坏了。第二项只说迟交，没有说原因。

groups.text: 假定李华打破了朋友借给他的杯子。

items.stem: Which action addresses the damaged cup?
options: I can return the broken cup to you tomorrow.
I will make it up to you in some way later.
I can be more careful next time.
I can replace the cup I accidentally broke.
items.why: 问题是杯子被打破。第四项提出赔一个新杯子，针对这一损失。第一项还回去的是打破的杯子，问题还在。

items.stem: Apologize for missing a planned meeting.
items.why: apologize for 后接动名词，missing our planned meeting 指出失约事项。

items.stem: Offer to send a missing document tonight.
items.why: can 后接 send，句子提出补发文件的具体安排。

groups.text: 假定李华因误记时间错过与同学的排练，需要道歉并提出补救。

items.stem: Which sentence identifies the mistake and reason?
options: I am sorry I missed rehearsal because I noted the wrong time.
I am sorry I missed rehearsal on Saturday afternoon.
I am sorry I missed rehearsal because the room had been changed.
I am sorry I was late for rehearsal because I noted the wrong time.
items.why: 情境给出两点：错过排练，原因是记错时间。第一项两点都说到了。第三项的原因与情境不符。

items.stem: Which action could address the missed rehearsal?
options: I will check the rehearsal time more carefully.
I can practice the missed part with you tomorrow.
I can explain when rehearsals usually begin.
I can bring a copy of the rehearsal schedule next week.
items.why: 问题是错过了排练。第二项提出明天和同学补练错过的部分，直接回应这一问题。

groups.text: 假定李华没有按时发送活动海报，因为误把文件存入了另一个文件夹。

options: The poster was sent before the deadline.
I am sorry that the poster was not sent to you on time.
I saved the file in the wrong folder by mistake.
I opened the correct folder after the activity.
items.why: 情境中的原因是把文件存进了另一个文件夹，第三项说的就是这一点。第二项只说没按时发，没有说原因。

items.stem: Which offer addresses the missing poster?
options: I can tell you how I named the folder.
I will be more careful with my files.
I can design a new poster for the next activity.
I can send the correct poster to you now.
items.why: 问题是海报没有按时发出。第四项现在就把正确的海报发过去，直接解决问题。

items.stem: Apologize for returning a borrowed book late.
items.why: apologize for 后接 returning，指出迟还书的事项。

items.stem: Offer to deliver a forgotten book tomorrow.
items.why: can 后接 bring，句子提出补送书籍的安排。

items.stem: Apologize for missing a scheduled visit.
items.why: sorry that 后接完整分句，说明错过约定的访问。

items.stem: Offer to send a corrected file this evening.
items.why: send the corrected file 提出发送更正文件的补救行动。
